payload.friendly_name: Prefix IDLE Cron Replies With Agent Slug
payload.purpose_context: While Felix sub-agents run in observed mode, bare four-character IDLE replies arrive in WhatsApp with no way to tell which agent fired which message. After incidents like the 2026-06-12 OpenClaw auth-store rotation, operators cannot confirm recovery without SSHing to office2 and inspecting per-job cron run logs. This mission updates the AGENTS.md Hard rule #1 across all five Felix sub-agents (felix-admin-capture, habits-agent, tasker-agent, escalation-agent, calendar-agent) to require the structured byte format [<agent-slug>]: IDLE - adding identity-attribution parity with non-IDLE replies while preserving the anti-narrative invariants from the 2026-05-20 and 2026-06-09 incidents.
payload.purpose_tldr: Tag every IDLE WhatsApp reply with the issuing agent's slug so observed-mode operators can attribute each ping without SSHing to office2.
